description: This file is the main entry point for a recipe scraping library/module. It defines an asynchronous function 'scrapeRecipe' that validates URLs, selects a scraping strategy, attempts to extract recipe data via multiple fallback methods (site-specific scraper, generic scraper, JSON-LD fallback), and normalizes the result into a standard schema. It also exports the primary scraping function and error types.

methods.name: scrapeRecipe(url, options = {})
methods.description: Main function to scrape a recipe from a URL. Validates the URL, chooses a scraping strategy, attempts site-specific and generic scraping, falls back to JSON-LD parsing, handles errors, and returns a normalized recipe object.
